Specification: This module provides Apalache-oriented type annotations and concrete helper definitions for an instance of the CigaretteSmokers specification. It declares constants for the set of ingredients and the set of offers, variables representing the smokers state and the dealer's offered ingredients, and then instantiates the separate CigaretteSmokers module without substitutions. The file itself does not define the transition system, actions, or temporal properties of the algorithm; instead, it adds typed declarations and concrete model-value sets intended for use from configuration, notably a three-element ingredient universe and the induced set of two-ingredient offers.
